title: artemisia vulgaris var. typica
intro: Artemisia vulgaris var. typica, commonly known as common mugwort, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, relieve menstrual cramps, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of common mugwort include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions include sedation, antiviral, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions.
